about: Cloudflare prices the G3 cost model uses (cost_model.mjs). Requests, Class B reads, storage and egress are the capacity report's, checked on Cloudflare's pricing pages 2026-10-27 (https://claude.ai/artifact/KRJ9rwmeShshfg1y3fvooQ). CPU time, Class A writes and Analytics Engine are not in that report: they are Cloudflare's published Workers Paid and R2 prices as known when this file was written, and should be checked again on Cloudflare's pricing pages before G3's numbers go to Sam (checked_extra is null until then).
